study type: Cross-sectional study, animal model, in vitro study
exposure: Labor status (in labor vs. not in labor)
cohort: Participants included nonpregnant women and four groups of pregnant women (preterm not in labor, preterm in labor with chorioamnionitis, term not in labor, term in labor) from whom myometrium was obtained at primary cesarean delivery.
finding: The expression of PCP4/PEP-19 was lowest in myometrium of women with preterm pregnancy and chorioamnionitis, and its decreased expression contributes to a loss of uterine quiescence in response to infection-induced inflammation.
cross-section timing: Myometrial samples were collected at the time of primary cesarean delivery for pregnant women and from nonpregnant women.
gest_age: The study included groups of preterm and term pregnant women, distinguishing by gestational age for sample collection.
